thread:
alex: Heads-up: plan a shepherded wave tonight 21:30 UTC. Pins: runtime=v1.12.3, router=v2.4.0, console=3.1.1. API surface unchanged. Need router/console header-swap gating + runtime warmup.

.deploy-bot: DeployBot: wave scheduled 2026-03-21T21:30:00Z. Canary plan queued: 1% @21:30, 5% @21:40, 15% @21:55, 60% @22:15. Will post step statuses.

emma: Quick safety check: any kernel or quant changes in runtime build? p99 risk?

carlos: Runtime lead here - only a small mem-tracker fix, no quant profile or kernel flags changed. We will pre-warm models; risk is cold-start p95.

priya: Router notes: we need to flip the console header (Console-Version) as part of this minor. We'll gate the header-swap behind feature flag `console_header_v3` and hold route flip until canary >= 15%. Also limiting steer from EU->APAC to 0 for the wave.

alex: Rollback triggers I'm proposing in release notes: error-rate increase > 4 percentage points OR p99 latency > 450ms sustained for 8m OR console 5xx > 0.5% of requests over 5m => immediate rollback. Thoughts?

emma: That looks reasonable. I'll run SLO baselines at 21:00 UTC and wire alerting to the shepherd channel. I'll also add a smoke runner that hits `/predict` then checks `/metrics` for JVM/container mem.

ops-shepherd: Oncall covered for the window. Rollback runbook: first fire the deploy-bot rollback, then revert pins manually if needed:
```
# rollback commands
deploy-bot rollback --wave=1718002222
# pin revert if bot rollback doesn't cover all services
runtime pin set v1.12.2
router pin set v2.3.9
console pin set 3.1.0
```
I'll confirm completion in #eng-oncall and ping infra if nodes don't drain.

carlos: Runtime healthcheck (use canary runner):
```
curl -sS -X POST https://runtime.redwood.internal/predict -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"ping"}' | jq '.status, .latency_ms'
```
Expect status==200 and latency <200ms for 5 consecutive warmups. Also check `/metrics` for kv_cache_hit_ratio > 0.7.

deploy-bot: Canary started 2026-03-21T21:30:00Z (1%). Posting updates to this thread.

emma: Preflight baseline done, attaching summary in docs. No regressions seen in dev cluster.

alex: TL;DR: scheduled wave 21:30 UTC, pinned runtime/router, console header-swap gated at 15% canary, rollback criteria in notes. Please ack by 20:45 UTC or raise blockers. :thumbsup:
